form.label: VM & Container Sysadmin
form.description: System logs, health and collection status. Health updates every minute; dashboard searches refresh every 2 minutes. Stale means no heartbeat for 3 minutes. Historical panels use the selected time range; current status uses recent samples. At-least-once events are deduplicated by event_id.

search.query: index=sysadmin_vm source=sysadmin:health host=$host|s$ | dedup event_id | fields _time host cpu_pct memory_pct load1 failed_services failed_units queue_events uptime

index=sysadmin_vm (source=sysadmin:journal OR source=sysadmin:collector_error OR source=sysadmin:pve_access) host=$host|s$ | dedup event_id | fields _time host kind priority severity unit process message http_status component

| inputlookup sysadmin_hosts.csv | where role!="pve" | search host=$host|s$ | join type=left host [search index=sysadmin_vm source=sysadmin:health earliest=-24h latest=now | stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(cpu_pct) as cpu_pct latest(memory_pct) as memory_pct latest(failed_services) as failed_services latest(queue_events) as queue_events latest(uptime) as uptime by host] | eval age_seconds=round(now()-last_seen), collection=case(isnull(last_seen),"MISSING",age_seconds>180,"STALE",true(),"OK")

index=sysadmin_vm source=sysadmin:filesystem host=$host|s$ | stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(disk_pct) as disk_pct latest(disk_available) as disk_available latest(inode_pct) as inode_pct by host mount

index=sysadmin_pve source=sysadmin:guest | stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(status) as status latest(type) as type latest(cpu_pct) as cpu_pct latest(memory_pct) as memory_pct latest(uptime) as uptime by vmid name | search name=$host|s$
| stats count(eval(collection="OK")) as reporting count as expected | eval coverage=reporting." / ".expected | fields coverage
| stats count(eval(collection!="OK")) as stale
| where priority<=3 | stats count as errors
| where collection="OK" | stats sum(failed_services) as failed_services

panel.title: Current host health and collection status

search.query: | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%F %T"), uptime_hours=round(uptime/3600,1) | table host role collection age_seconds cpu_pct memory_pct failed_services queue_events uptime_hours last_seen
| eval age_seconds=round(now()-last_seen) | table vmid name type status cpu_pct memory_pct age_seconds
| timechart span=5m avg(cpu_pct) by host
| timechart span=5m avg(memory_pct) by host

| eval available_GiB=round(disk_available/1024/1024/1024,2), status=case(disk_pct>=90,"CRITICAL",disk_pct>=80,"WARNING",true(),"OK") | sort - disk_pct | table host mount status disk_pct available_GiB inode_pct
index=sysadmin_vm source=sysadmin:network host=$host|s$ | dedup event_id | eval throughput_kbps=rx_kbps+tx_kbps | timechart span=5m avg(throughput_kbps) by host
| timechart span=5m count by severity
| where match(message,"(?i)(failed password|authentication failure|invalid user|failed authentication|authentication failed)") | sort - _time | table _time host process message | head 50
| where priority<=4 | sort - _time | table _time host severity unit process message | head 100
| search kind=collector_error | sort - _time | table _time host component message | head 50
| sort - _time | table _time host severity unit process message | head 100
